requirements.title: F_C_STRING argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING is a scalar character argument of kind C_CHAR, and optional ASIS is a logical scalar.

pending.F_C_STRING-STRING-scalar-c-char: Guarded positive source control first requires C_CHAR > 0, declares CHARACTER(6,KIND=C_CHAR) :: s='abc   ' and calls F_C_STRING(s); mutations use default kind and rank-one array separately and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.F_C_STRING-ASIS-logical-scalar: Positive source control calls F_C_STRING(s,.TRUE.) and F_C_STRING(s,.FALSE.); mutation passes integer 1 as ASIS and claims no diagnostic facet.
